description: Use this when the user wants a human coach of their own: 1:1 coaching, someone who writes their program for them, checks in each week, reviews how they move or answers their messages, for example "I want a real coach for basketball" or "can someone coach me one on one?". It returns the Phorme coaches taking 1:1 clients now, with what the coaching includes, how many spots are open and the coach's page, where the terms and joining are. It shows no prices, books nothing and changes nothing. Coaching is training, not medical care.

goal.description: What the user wants coaching for, in their words, only if they said.

sport.description: Their sport, only if they named one.

name: find_personal_coach

coaches.description: Each coach taking 1:1 clients: coach, coach_url, offer, summary, includes, spots (status, detail, open), page_url, how_it_starts, and free_review (open, page_url) when the coach has a free plan review spot this week.

limits.description: What this does not cover. Tell the user.

title: Find a personal coach
